title: Twenty-sided polynomial decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) and budget 7 with cached final-position contributions

claims.statement: The explicit two-component 2000-use polynomial-tag decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) and a per-group cost cap of 7 has uniform-message average block error at most 94863964805926507/100000000000000000 on BSC(1/10).
The same fixed bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes exactly W=408895702230 primitives on every input, with W<=2^(771459/20000).

experiments.purpose: Verify exact tag and leader spectra and the independent pair bounds by support. The final sector checks exact admitted volume, block error, memory and RAM cost.
